title: Women Owning Woodlands: Empowering and Supporting All Small Forest Landowners
content: Women Owning Woodlands (WOW; womenowningwoodlands.org) is a national network that provides female-focused forestry programming through virtual and in-person workshops, webinars, field tours, downloadable literature, and a social media presence. The target audience is women, but WOW is beneficial to any underserved community that is new to forest management, including non-binary and gender- nonconforming communities. WOW supports women in forest leadership, women who manage their own woodlands, or anyone who facilitates the stewardship of forests. It does so by equipping woodland owners, managers, and stewards with the information they need to take on an active role in stewardship. Empowering and supporting all small forest landowners to achieve their management objectives is important, because ultimately, keeping working forests within the landscape is beneficial to us all.
